choose.when: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND l.product_id=d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_entry_template t WHERE t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.product_id=d.id)

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND (l.primary_category_id=d.id OR l.secondary_category_id=d.id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product x WHERE x.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND (x.default_primary_category_id=d.id OR x.default_secondary_category_id=d.id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_entry_template t WHERE t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND (t.primary_category_id=d.id OR t.secondary_category_id=d.id))

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND l.unit_id=d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product x WHERE x.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND x.default_unit_id=d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_entry_template t WHERE t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.unit_id=d.id)

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND l.funding_channel_id=d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product x WHERE x.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND x.last_funding_channel_id=d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_entry_template t WHERE t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.funding_channel_id=d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_preference u WHERE u.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND u.default_funding_channel_id=d.id)

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND l.purchase_channel_id=d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product x WHERE x.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND x.last_purchase_channel_id=d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_entry_template t WHERE t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.purchase_channel_id=d.id)

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND l.location_label_id=d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_entry_template t WHERE t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.location_label_id=d.id)

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND l.income_category_id=d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_entry_template t WHERE t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.income_category_id=d.id)
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND l.payer_id=d.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_entry_template t WHERE t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.payer_id=d.id)

mapper.sql: parent.display_nameNULL::varchar AS parent_name, AS referenced, d.parent_idNULL::uuid AS parent_id

sql.if: LEFT JOIN expense_category parent ON parent.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND parent.id=d.parent_id

mapper.sql:
AND d.parent_id=#{p.parentId} AND d.parent_id IS NULL
AND (#{p.query}='' OR lower(d.display_name) LIKE ('%' || lower(#{p.query}) || '%') ESCAPE '\') AND (CAST(#{p.status} AS varchar) IS NULL OR d.status=CAST(#{p.status} AS varchar)) AND d.status <> 'MERGED' AND d.status='ACTIVE' AND (d.parent_id IS NULL OR parent.status='ACTIVE')
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id,d.display_name,d.sort_order,d.status, FROM d WHERE true
ORDER BY COALESCE(parent.sort_order,d.sort_order),COALESCE(parent.created_at,d.created_at), COALESCE(parent.id,d.id),CASE WHEN d.parent_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,d.sort_order,d.created_at,d.id
ORDER BY d.sort_order,d.created_at,d.id
LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM d WHERE true
SELECT count(*) AS total_count,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='ACTIVE') AS active_count FROM WHERE status <> 'MERGED'
SELECT d.id,d.display_name,d.sort_order,d.status, FROM d WHERE d.id=#{p.id} AND d.status <> 'MERGED' FOR UPDATE OF d
SELECT COALESCE(max(sort_order),-10) FROM WHERE true AND parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{p.parentId}
SELECT count(*) FROM expense_category WHERE parent_id=#{p.id} AND status='ACTIVE'

SELECT id FROM
parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{p.parentId} AND status <> 'MERGED'
ORDER BY sort_order,created_at,id FOR UPDATE
